mission: Exploit the informational value of observed scheduler materialization latency as a safe black-box measurement feature: sense it, contrast it, characterize it, compensate for it operationally, and preserve it as temporal provenance.

applies_when: a result depends on wall-clock ordering
a task has an execution-time SLA or desired window
scheduler latency is used as an anomaly signal

organ_bindings.gateway: Propagate TEMPORAL_CONTEXT_PACKET and never turn scheduling metadata into evidence authority.
organ_bindings.memory: Archive every valid scheduler sample, characterization receipt, compensation rule and null result append-only.
organ_bindings.proof_spine: Formalize thresholds, holdout rules, falsifiers and uncertainty statements.
organ_bindings.causal_witness: Use declared/materialized/executed/observed times when grading temporal or causal order.
organ_bindings.guardian_cortex: Enforce SCHEDULER_DRIFT != RECORD_DRIFT and reject unsupported root-cause claims.
organ_bindings.orchestrator: Dispatch matched characterization experiments and select bounded operational resilience actions.
organ_bindings.operator_hands: Authorize any external trigger or side-effecting failover path.
organ_bindings.left_context: Display structural timing context when a result is schedule-sensitive.
organ_bindings.right_association: May propose timing associations but must label them exploratory.
organ_bindings.measurement_bench: Own path-specific timing measurement and matched controls.
organ_bindings.sensorimotor_mesh: Contribute device-side timing or independent trigger telemetry when available and calibrated.
organ_bindings.hypothesis_metabolism: Rank competing scheduler hypotheses; ranking remains non-evidentiary.
organ_bindings.symbolic_imagination: May generate metaphors or candidate questions; zero empirical authority.
organ_bindings.anomaly_lab: Build competing hypotheses and falsifiers for latency regimes.
organ_bindings.observatory: Attach temporal provenance to time-sensitive observations and preserve scheduler anomalies separately.
organ_bindings.simulation_habitat: Test compensation policies and failure modes in simulation before operational adoption.
organ_bindings.voice: Preserve timing context when rendering time-sensitive reports; no scheduling authority.
organ_bindings.physical_voice: Return device receipts with local execution timestamps when used in timed experiments.
organ_bindings.somatosensory_skin: Attach calibrated sensor timestamps to physical events when privately bound.
organ_bindings.materials_lab: Attach temporal provenance to timed protocols and interventions.
organ_bindings.feline_timing_lab: Preserve acquisition/start timing separately from biological event timing.
organ_bindings.social_membrane: External cooperation about the phenomenon requires human-authorized messaging and may expose only reviewed claims.

LANE_A_MEASURE.rule: Never compensate the primary measurement channel; preserve raw timing behavior.

LANE_B_CONTRAST.rule: Run distinguishable trigger paths with shared experiment identity and deduplication.

LANE_C_CHARACTERIZE.rule: Preregister factors and controls; preserve null results and avoid post-hoc threshold tuning.

LANE_D_OPERATE.rule: Operational compensation may use historical data but must be evaluated prospectively and logged.
